question: Where does the goddess who holds her attributes abide within the sacred diagram?
premises: The goddess is described as holding her attributes.
She abides in the pericarp of an auspicious lotus.
This lotus is located in the new womb.
inference: The worshipper visualizes the goddess as dwelling in the pericarp of the auspicious lotus within the new womb.
uncertainties: The exact referent of navayoni in this ritual context is not fully specified.
plain_english: One should contemplate her as holding her attributes and abiding in the pericarp of the auspicious lotus within the new womb.
